description: Start a full CookieInspector scan with a real browser (before and after the consent click, up to 5 pages) on the connected account. Optional region: main (US East), us-west, eu-de (Germany, for EU-targeted banners). Uses the plan's monthly scans. Returns a scanId to poll with get_scan_status, then get_scan_summary. Technical findings, not legal advice.

region.description: Scan location: main, us-west or eu-de

url.description: The website to scan, absolute, e.g. https://example.com

name: start_scan
title: Start a full scan
